title: SPLASH - Princess X95
description:
The Princess X95 is one of the flagships of the Princess range, distinguished by its Super Flybridge concept: a flybridge and main deck extending nearly the full length of the hull, for far more living space than standard yachts of similar size.

SPLASH offers a light-filled saloon, an enclosed sky lounge with panoramic views, two master staterooms and five guest cabins in total. Extremely well cared for, she is lying in West Palm Beach, Florida.
